headline: Ministry of Economy explains whether sanctions against Kim threaten Wildberries' problems in the KR
summary: Wildberries founder Tatiana Kim has left the chief executive post of the marketplace and will continue on strategic development. Kyrgyz authorities addressed whether possible sanctions against Kim would affect the company's operations in Kyrgyzstan.
why: Wildberries is one of Russia's largest online marketplaces, and leadership changes there can affect its strategy and regional operations. Sanctions exposure is a key risk for investors in Russian-linked companies.
original_headline: В Минэкономе объяснили, грозят ли санкции против Ким проблемами Wildberries в КР
